verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Insomnia is an API design tool in Kong's ecosystem, so APIOps-style declarative config is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent capabilities. Git Sync stores Insomnia project data in a Git repo, and Inso CLI can lint specs and run tests in CI. Nothing documents managing API infrastructure, such as gateway routes or services, as declarative config or syncing it to infrastructure from CI.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can manage API infrastructure as declarative config and sync it from CI (GitOps/APIOps)
